# v0.6.14

## Bug Fixes
- Hide unwanted CMD console window on Windows using CREATE_NO_WINDOW flag
- Fix folder auto-save, theme colors, and update check placement

## Features
- Tauri auto-update system with signature verification
- Custom app icons
- Notification settings

## Documentation
- Complete README rewrite with installation-first structure
- Updated prerequisites with correct versions and links
- Simplified installation instructions (CMD only)
